fresh_physical_binding_sequence: After the120-case completion/worker-stop prerequisite and separately reviewed launch, validate only own direct host/UID/process/source/lock metadata before any numerical import. Preserve failures before returning.
Preserve CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES exactly as the approved UUID; reject numeric, multiple, absent, other UUID or changed selectors. Do not discover/select by NVML index, physical minor or PCI sorting.

Initialize only the exact process singleton JAX GPU on the unchanged runtime. Through the actually mapped driver with RTLD_NOLOAD, require CUDA device count1, successful ordinal0 handle, non-null existing current context and context device equal that handle. No context creation/reset/fallback.

Query native CUDA UUID and PCI for that device and require UUID equal the authorized card-one UUID. Record explicitly that JAX linkage is the sole local JAX GPU/sole CUDA-visible ordinal/current-context relation, not a direct JAX UUID/PCI property read.

Only after native UUID/PCI proof, query hardware by that exact UUID for model, physical total, driver and memory. Use bounded strict UTF8 CSV, complete raw hashes/counts and exact allowed fields. No global XML or other-card query.

Join native UUID/PCI to only its exact NVIDIA proc information and physical character-device major/minor with stable ordinary metadata. Never equate a CUDA compute-capability minor, CUDA ordinal or NVML index with the physical device minor.

Copy the actually mapped driver/backend images into immutable shared artifacts before the process ends, using the reviewed capture contracts. Later metadata/portable evidence reads captured bytes only, preserving node-local paths as identity metadata.

Save immutable resolved binding and verify source/config/software/assets/precision/full correctness gates unchanged. Only then may environment/learner/profile work begin under the same lock and source.

immutable_plan_and_records.failure: Reserve one attempt; preserve complete or partial metadata/native/query/driver evidence on failure. No repeat, binding rewrite, guessed physical query or upgrade of an old failure.
immutable_plan_and_records.launch: Before numerical work, record/fsync the exact owned process launch row and immutable parent/child release records without guessing PIDs. Source validation and publication use the existing source/queue metadata locking discipline.
immutable_plan_and_records.metadata: Each real parent/child records its own PID, positive birth, parent PID/birth where applicable, all four kernel UIDs, host, original environment and source/helper receipt before numerical imports. Direct metadata requires no Slurm allocation variables.
immutable_plan_and_records.parent_child_layout: Use original unit for actual numerical child metadata/binding and unit/supervisor for metadata-only profiling parent. Parent evidence may not replace the actual child process evidence.
immutable_plan_and_records.plan: Original unit measurement_plan.json and measurement_prepared.json stay immutable for selected and profile consumers. The plan records the separately named direct profile, approved UUID, pending physical identity, original source/config/runtime/assets/gates, future current binding path and the worker-stop/source-admission receipts.
immutable_plan_and_records.resolved_binding: A new immutable actual binding ties exact raw plan/prepared/admission/stop/launch/lock receipts, current process, original UUID selector, native CUDA context/UUID/PCI, sole-JAX linkage, proc/device identity and current hardware. It is never represented as a UVA binding.

minimal_later_implementation_scope: One separately named direct qualifier/binding module and focused metadata tests, reusing generic pinned read/current-context/shared-image capture helpers without importing UVA service-configuration trust.
One explicit direct producer branch and observer-policy adapter in an isolated worktree. Defaults and A4500 implementation remain unchanged for their existing inputs.
Strict unsupported-reader guards and conditional complete staged helper closure; cold default/direct/combined tests and missing-sibling refusal.
Separate reviewed zero-credit GPU component fixture after publication and exact original-worker exit proof. No such fixture or launch is authorized by this design.

observer_interface_agreed_with_producer_.error_precedence: Preserve the original numerical failure; sampler shutdown/contamination errors remain recorded separately and cannot turn a failed run into valid performance evidence.
observer_interface_agreed_with_producer_.paired_hook: Only the opt-in context temporarily replaces the frozen paired sampler with the validated assigned-device observer. Restore the original class on success or failure. Do not edit F, Executor numerical code, source configuration, seeds, report schedule or default branches.
observer_interface_agreed_with_producer_.required_new_interface: A reviewed direct-specific binding policy validates the complete direct binding and returns exact approved target UUID, actual PID/birth, parsed physical total/model/driver and immutable binding/custody receipt. Shared mechanics accept only this literal direct policy or the existing exact UVA policy; no loose total override and no UVA-kind impersonation.
observer_interface_agreed_with_producer_.scope_and_interval: Keep the reviewed0.2s sampling interval. Every hardware sample is exact bound UUID; occupancy uses only the root-approved assigned-UUID process query after binding, with the allowed PID set bound to the actual process/capture policy. Any other PID, malformed/partial/anonymous record or sampler failure invalidates the window without inspecting that foreign process.
observer_interface_agreed_with_producer_.timing_and_startup: Begin the relevant observer before each unchanged warmup/timed/report window, retain normal shutdown/liveness/error proof and complete-window timing. Explicitly label CUDA initialization before binding as startup_memory_observed=false; do not claim a lifetime peak. Instrumented startup/capacity use remains unsupported until an explicit handshake covers its whole claimed interval.
observer_interface_agreed_with_producer_.total_and_headroom: Physical total comes from the fresh exact UUID hardware query and must equal the approved profile95830MiB. CUDA context-available total and allocator limits remain separate observations. Keep existing>=15% actual physical free-memory requirements and below10% packing decisions unchanged; this design grants no packing credit.
unsupported_until_separate_explicit_supp: ordinary or portable formal readers which do not understand this binding

proposed_profile.expected_values_authority: The exact latest saved approved-UUID hardware row referenced above; every value must be checked again against the current bound device.
proposed_profile.name: direct-serval02-card-1-current-process-and-standing-lock-version-1
proposed_profile.physical_identity_basis: Current process native CUDA UUID/PCI/current context plus sole local JAX device and exact NVIDIA proc/minor join, under direct user authorization and an explicitly proved standing lock.

required_tests_before_publication: Wrong/missing profile or UUID, other host/owner, any Slurm allocation, stale/incomplete worker-stop/source admission, changed helper/source/config/runtime/gates and missing published capability reject.

Wrong or replaced lock inode/path/owner, alias/FIFO, missing FLOCK, wrong parent/child birth, lost inherited fd or Nsight dropping it reject before numerical imports; do not accept a busy-lock test alone.

Non-singleton JAX/CUDA, null/wrong current context, changed original selector, wrong native UUID/PCI, mistaken compute-capability minor, relabelled proc/device metadata or changed captured image reject.
Exact current H100 model/driver/95830MiB total is mandatory; arbitrary or A4500/UVA-binding substitutions reject. Keep the old A4500 fixed policy unchanged.
Assigned-UUID-only hardware/occupancy commands, strict encoding/byte/hash checks, foreign/anonymous rows, contamination, sampler early exit and incomplete stop/window coverage reject.
Immutable binding/failure attempts survive reload; parent metadata cannot substitute for child; no frozen-plan rewrite. Missing/unsupported formal/capacity/final/portable readers refuse.
Full existing source/config/precision/timing/report/confirmation/headroom gates remain intact; metadata-only fixtures grant no physical or scientific credit.

standing_lock_custody.path_policy: Use only the existing ordinary lock path with O_NOFOLLOW and a pinned inode. Verify UID2618919, ordinary file, exact fd/path device+inode and unchanged metadata. Do not unlink, replace or create a second lock. /tmp is handled as the existing sticky directory; no blanket root-only or service-UID directory policy is introduced. Changed/missing/aliased lock identity requires review.
standing_lock_custody.profile_child: The actual Python capture child must prove the inherited fd exists, its fstat matches the exact approved parent-held lock device/inode, and its own fdinfo carries the matching FLOCK. Bind exact recorded parent/Nsight/child births using the existing capture-release chain before JAX. If Nsight drops the descriptor or custody cannot be proved, refuse before CUDA. Do not attempt a second lock acquisition or infer custody from a busy pathname.
standing_lock_custody.profile_supervisor: The explicit direct profile branch of card_admission yields the acquired descriptor and records parent PID/birth/all UIDs, fd and lock device/inode. Launch Nsight with pass_fds=(fd,) and keep the original descriptor held until exact child/Nsight terminal and capture-summary evidence.
standing_lock_custody.same_process_selected: The actual selected process acquires the existing exclusive FLOCK before JAX/CUDA import, holds its descriptor through source admission, binding, all warmup/timing/report windows and result publication, then releases it. Save its own fdinfo FLOCK and birth/UID proof; merely observing a busy lock is insufficient.
standing_lock_custody.window_custody: Every admitted window starts and ends with the same own/parent-held descriptor and process/custody proof. The parent cannot release before terminal-child proof. Loss of holder identity, fd, FLOCK or exact birth invalidates the attempt and its timing; never substitute another current process.
